programs.detail: Supreme Court held 2026-02-20 that IEEPA does not authorize tariffs. Entire 9903.01.xx layer eliminated prospectively, including the 9903.01.33 auto-parts carve-out. Ruling did not touch Section 232 or Section 301.

10% global surcharge expired by operation of law 12:01 a.m. 2026-07-24 (150 days after effect). No extension legislation. 301-FL turned on the same instant — 301-FL is the functional replacement, not an addition.
programs.compute_caveat: Historical only — apply when Entry Date is 2026-02-24..2026-07-23

programs.detail: Section 301 Forced Labor, CSMS #69326983, effective 2026-07-24 (headings mainly 9903.05.20+). No sunset. Mutually exclusive with Section 232 autos/parts — 232 wins via 9903.05.90 suppression. Brazil country 301 (9903.05.01–.09) is a separate program that can stack with FL (e.g. BR → .01 + .27).

Proclamation 10908. Passenger vehicles/light trucks auto-apply 9903.94.01 @ 25% from the CSMS #64624801 list. Auto-parts annex (U.S. note 33) auto-applies 9903.94.05; Japan parts top-up 9903.94.43. MHDV is a separate program (Proclamation 10984).

Proclamation 10984 / CSMS #66665333, effective 2025-11-01. MHDV vehicles 9903.74.01 @ 25%, buses 9903.74.02 @ 10% from the published HTS lists. MHDV parts 9903.74.08 is claim-gated (9903.74.11 exists for listed articles that are not MHDV parts). Not subject to 232 metals or wood when MHDV applies.
Proclamation 10976 / CSMS #66492057, effective 2025-10-14. Softwood 9903.76.01 @ 10%. Upholstered furniture and kitchen cabinets 25% (UK 10% / JP 15% / EU 15%). Autos 232 wins if both apply.

January 14, 2026 proclamation / CSMS #67400472, effective 2026-01-15. 9903.79.01 @ 25% only when HTS is 8471.50 / 8471.80 / 8473.30 AND Note 39(b) TPP/DRAM params are claimed (flags.s232_semiconductor). 0% headings .02–.09 are claim-gated exclusions. Claimed .01 wins over autos/MHDV/metals.
programs.compute_caveat: Do not infer TPP/DRAM bandwidth from HTS — duty path is claim-gated

programs.detail: CSMS #68253075 / U.S. note 16. 9903.82.02 assesses +50% on metal-content value (R4). 9903.82.09 assesses +25% on entered value for copper articles and derivative aluminum/steel. Mutually exclusive with 301-FL → 9903.05.90. Suppresses Sec 122 via 9903.03.06 (R2b). Chapter triage 72–74/76; annex derivatives outside those chapters are claim-gated when 9903.82.09 / 9903.03.06 are filed.
programs.compute_caveat: Do not fold into parts TOTAL

programs.detail: Legacy China 301 lists. NOT suppressed by 232 — both report, 301 first. Also stacks with Sec 122 (9903.03.01) when the line is outside the 232 universe. Continues in the 301-FL era alongside 9903.05.xx.

CSMS #69302472 / 91 FR 45516. Additional 25% on products of Brazil from 2026-07-22. Exempt headings 9903.05.02–.09 (232 universe → .07). Distinct from 301-FL Brazil flat 9903.05.27 (12.5% from 2026-07-24); both stack when applicable (FR note 50).
JP/EU/KR 15% headings confirmed at rate level. MFN cap mechanic (zeroed vs conditional) unresolved. KR/TW heading assignment unresolved.
